issues.description: The problem statement and the client/assembly code expect a Book property named 'title' (and construct Books using Book(title: ...)), but the Book struct in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift defines the property as 'bookTitle'. This identifier mismatch (bookTitle vs title) makes the client and assembly code inconsistent with the Book definition and will cause compilation errors and confusion for students.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Book struct use the property name 'title' (not 'bookTitle') so it matches the problem statement and the Client/assembly usage. Concretely, change 'let bookTitle: String' to 'let title: String' (and adjust any initializer/memberwise parameter names accordingly), or alternatively update all usages and initializers to use 'bookTitle' consistently — but aligning to 'title' is recommended to match the specification.
